title: U.S. government will decide who gets to use GPT-5.6
summary: The U.S. government is implementing a vetting process to determine which users can access OpenAI's GPT-5.6 model, representing a significant shift toward government oversight of advanced AI technology. This marks one of the first instances where a national government is directly involved in controlling access to frontier AI models for security and strategic reasons.
problem_solved: Addresses concerns about who should have access to powerful AI systems that could pose national security risks if misused.
why_valuable: This represents a landmark moment in AI governance, showing how governments are beginning to actively regulate access to cutting-edge AI capabilities rather than leaving access decisions solely to private companies.
